tasks.title: Add CLI issue create model passthrough
tasks.description: Extend `mo issue create` so it accepts `--model <provider/model>` and includes that value in the existing `POST /api/issues` request after body ingestion resolves `--body`, `@file`, or stdin. Keep validation thin on the CLI side so invalid model strings fail through the existing API error path with exit code 1.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue create "Title" --model openai/gpt-4o` sends model in the create request body
`mo issue create "Title" --body @body.md --model anthropic/claude-sonnet` still resolves the file body and sends model in the same request
`mo issue create "Title" --body - --model anthropic/claude-sonnet` still resolves stdin body and sends model in the same request
When the API rejects an invalid model format, the CLI prints the error and exits with code 1
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not add a second model validator in the CLI; reuse existing server-side validation semantics.

tasks.title: Add Web UI priority controls to create and edit issue flows
tasks.description: Update the Web issue client and dialogs so `priority` is a first-class field in create and update flows. `CreateIssueDialog` should default to `p2`, `EditIssueDialog` should load the current issue priority, and both dialogs should use one shared Web priority-style mapping consistent with current CLI semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: `api.createIssue` and `api.updateIssue` request types accept `priority`
Create Issue dialog renders a priority selector with p0-p4 options and defaults to p2
Edit Issue dialog renders a priority selector and initializes it from the issue's current priority
Saving from either dialog sends the selected priority through the issue API
Priority colors in the dialogs follow the existing semantic mapping: p0/p1 red, p2 yellow, p3 green, p4 gray
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Also updates `packages/cli/web/src/components/EditIssueDialog.tsx`, `packages/cli/web/src/lib/api.ts`, `packages/cli/web/src/lib/types.ts`, and any shared Web priority styling helper.

tasks.title: Implement URL-backed Kanban query state and derived board transforms
tasks.description: Add a board-specific query state layer that reads and writes priority filters, label filters, title search, and sort mode from the URL, then derives the displayed board from the single `useIssues(projectId)` result. The transformation pipeline should normalize missing priority to `p2`, apply additive filters, and sort each stage consistently for both desktop and mobile board rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: Board state can round-trip priority filter, label filter, search text, and sort mode through `location.search`
Derived board data filters issues by selected priorities and labels before stage counts are rendered
Title search filters issues case-insensitively by title only
Sort mode supports `priority`, `number`, and `updated` with deterministic tie-breakers
Refreshing the board restores the same filter, sort, and search state from the URL
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer a small hook or helper module over scattering URL parsing and serialization through multiple components.

tasks.title: Integrate Kanban filter and sort controls across desktop and mobile views
tasks.description: Render the new board controls in the Kanban surface and connect them to the shared query-state layer so all stage counts and issue lists update live. Desktop multi-column view and mobile single-column view should consume the same derived columns, and each column should expose the shared sort switch without diverging into per-column sort state.
acceptanceCriteria: Kanban top bar shows priority filter, label filter, and title search input
Changing any control updates displayed issue counts and stage lists without a full page reload
Each stage column can switch the shared sort mode between priority, number, and updated
Mobile single-column board view reflects the same filtered and sorted issue set as desktop
Existing done-column collapse/archive behavior still works after board controls are added
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task should wire the visible controls and column UI on top of the query-state and transform layer built in T-003.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage for CLI create parity and Kanban query behavior
tasks.description: Add targeted automated coverage for the two user-visible outcomes introduced by this change: CLI create with model plus body ingestion combinations, and Web board restoration/filtering behavior driven by URL state. Cover both valid and invalid paths so the parity contract and board usability contract stay protected.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover `mo issue create` with `--model` plus plain body, `@file`, and stdin body sources
Tests cover invalid model format surfacing as a failed create command with a clear error
Tests cover restoring board priority/filter/search/sort state from the URL
Tests cover filtered stage counts and filtered issue lists updating from the shared board query state
Relevant test suite passes
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use existing backend CLI test patterns and current Web component test setup rather than introducing a new test harness.
